slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must be kept for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed; it only discussed how areas add across covered months.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths must be signed; it only asked about mutual exclusion pairs.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is that the intended interpretation — that the areas from all chosen contracts simply add up in each month they cover, and the sum must be at least the required area for that month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly sums must be at least the required area, prompting confirmation that exact equality with no shortage or excess is required.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The objective is to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months, right? And the total cost is the sum over all chosen contracts of (rental fee per 100㎡ × area rented / 100)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost over the four months.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract lengths is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum-diversity requirement, and the READY_TO_MODEL model omits any constraint requiring at least two distinct contract lengths.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no cap on the number of distinct contract lengths that can be signed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts, and the READY_TO_MODEL model includes no such limit.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is effectively used for its full coverage period, with no separate full-coverage obligation needed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether a signed contract must be kept for all months in its term; the model links x_k to y_k but does not explicitly confirm the full-period obligation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved and was silently omitted from the model.

summary: The agent resolved the core P0 demand and objective slots but missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and the P2 full-coverage and contract-count limits, stopping with an incomplete model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
